pulse.text: **Anthropic's next Mythos-class model firmed sharply this evening** — its Sep 30 leg climbed to **74% from 69%**, with the Aug 31 leg up to 27%, the clearest odds move of the sweep. OpenAI's Astra drifted the same way, to **80% by Sep 30 (up from 77%)**, while GPT-6 slipped a point to 87% by year-end and Google's next Gemini Pro held flat at 50% by Aug 31. **No new models shipped in the last three hours** — GPT-5.6-Cyber and Meta's open-weight Muse Glimmer, both from this morning, remain the day's only additions, and the leaderboard is unchanged with **Claude Opus 5 on top at AA-Index 63**. Anthropic still holds **94% for best model on Aug 31** and 67% at year-end, and traders give a Chinese lab only 9% odds of taking the #1 slot by December. Two clocks are nearly out: Grok 4.6's Aug 15 window, with still no xAI model card published, and Alibaba's promised Qwen3.8-Max open weights, absent from Hugging Face on the last full day of the promised week.
